mechanism: Clarithromycin can cause QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, and hyperkalemia increases arrhythmia risk; clarithromycin may also impair renal function, reducing potassium excretion.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and ECG during concurrent use; ensure adequate renal function before and during clarithromycin therapy; consider alternative antibiotic if hyperkalemia present.
